acquisition.directories.title: Change task directories
acquisition.directories.hint: Set download, processing and delivery directories for this task. Execution history is retained; changing directories does not start the task.
acquisition.directories.moveFiles: Also move files from the original directory
acquisition.directories.pending: The previous directory move is unfinished. Resume the same operation to preserve files already moved.
acquisition.directories.blocked: Directories cannot be changed while this task is active.
acquisition.directories.moving: Checking and moving files. Please wait.
acquisition.directories.noStageInput: This stage has no file directory. Set its directory and place the files to process there first.
acquisition.directories.error.STAGE_DIRE: Stop the active task before changing directories.

Directories cannot be changed for this task.
The directory selection is invalid.
The task changed. Close and reopen directory settings.
The task revision limit was reached.
Resume the unfinished directory change first.

The target directory is unavailable.
